subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid x-openclaw-agent-id make OpenAI-compatible endpoints ignore or tolerate a generic body model such as gpt-4, despite the documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The source change is small, but it changes public API semantics for model selection and needs a consistent choice across Chat Completions, Responses, and possibly Embeddings.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat body model as compatibility metadata when a valid agent header is present, then update shared resolver behavior, docs, and endpoint tests for the chosen endpoint set.

options.title: Preserve agent-first model contract
options.body: Continue rejecting generic body models and document SDK integrations to send openclaw/default or openclaw/<agentId> plus x-openclaw-model for backend overrides.

options.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose a consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and Embeddings before queueing another fix PR.

recommendation.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers choose a consistent precedence rule for Chat Completions, Responses, and Embeddings before queueing another fix PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant agent-first model contract and compatibility expansion trace most directly to this owner path.
